query: SELECT s.id, s.title, s.artist, COUNT(v.id) as totalVotes FROM songs s LEFT JOIN votes v ON s.id = v.songId GROUP BY s.id HAVING totalVotes > 0 ORDER BY totalVotes DESC LIMIT 10;
